newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL spot tin price falls on LME, poor demand.
newsitem.headline: KL spot tin price falls on LME, poor demand.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price fell 14 cents to finish at 13.77 ringgit ($5.46) a kg after a weaker London market discouraged overseas buying, traders said.

"Copper fell in London, and other metals including spot tin follow suit," a trader said, adding that lack of foreign demand also dampened sentiment. Dealers noted an opening bid of only nine tonnes against offer of 100. Turnover was 90 tonnes, against 131 on Thursday.
Traders said near-term trend would depend on London's performance. The local price premium over London was $40 a tonne against $60 previously. -- ($1=2.5200 ringgit)
